candidates.description: This feature vector represents psychoactive substances, pharmaceuticals, and related medical conditions or disorders.
This feature vector represents the root, prefix, and morphological variants associated with legal, criminal, and critical terminology.
This vector represents common suffixes and roots associated with Romance language morphology, particularly adverbial and nominal forms in Italian, Spanish, and Portuguese.
This feature detects fragments and root words associated with legal, medical, and penal terminology as well as proper names.
This vector is related to Portuguese past participles, verb forms, and suffix-based morphological derivations.
This feature vector activates strongly on words and subwords starting with the prefix "pre-".
These tokens represent biomedical terms, organ systems, and physiological or medical conditions.
This vector represents Portuguese words and roots related to the verb "to be" and the nouns for "state" or "states".
This feature vector activates on terms related to neurology, neuroscience, and brain anatomy.
